scope: Read-only independent source review and raw receipt verification; no test/build/browser actions by reviewer.
contracts: Browser compatibility limit 16 matches the reviewed backend. Lowercase unique hashes, 64 KiB save size, 256 discoveries, ownership checks and private-data exclusions remain intact.
The layout effect reveals the paragraph once when failure appears inside its scroll container; it does not move focus or replay mutations.
The focus test waits for the actual pending disabled render and native blur, then checks that revealing the error causes no additional focus movement.
